name: adaptyv
description: Curated Adaptyv/ProteinBase de novo binder pool, 4 targets (EGFR, IL7R, Nipah glycoprotein G, PD-L1), with replicated binding calls
source: Adaptyv Bio binder-design competition rounds, published via proteinbase.com. Labels derived on 2026-10-03 from two raw exports on the MUNI share: 00_source_data/proteinbase_all_data_28_01_2026.csv (egfr, il7r, pd-l1) and 00_source_data/proteinbase_collection_nipah-binder-competition-results.csv (nipah). See that directory's README.md and PROVENANCE.md.
label_meaning: `binds`: 1 = measured binder, 0 = measured non-binder, derived from the raw exports' `evaluations` records (type=experimental, metric=binding) aggregated over replicates by majority -- median 6 replicates per (design, target); n_binding_replicates and replicates_disagree carry that per row, and 7 of 2018 pairs have replicates that disagree. `outcome` is the REQUIRED explicit form -- bound / not_bound / not_tested / excluded:<reason> -- and the loader refuses any row that lacks it. All 2018 rows here are measured, so the vocabulary used is bound (325) and not_bound (1693); no row is not_tested. `expressed` is aggregated per DESIGN, not per (design, target): it records whether the protein was produced at all, which cannot differ by the target it was screened against. The 223 expressed=False rows were assayed and showed no binding, so they are not_bound with `expressed` kept as its own column rather than folded into the outcome.
caveats: FOUR. (1) 'Adaptyv' and 'ProteinBase' are ONE dataset, not two corroborating ones -- proteinbase.com publishes the Adaptyv competition results, and the share's adaptyv_662 and proteinbase_175 directories are two refold batches over the same designs (75.6% overlap), so their near-identical AUCs were close to tautological rather than independent replication. (2) Only 563 of these 2018 designs were scored by all three refold engines (egfr 190/826, il7r 96/96, nipah 211/1030, pd-l1 66/66). Every published macro-AUC from this pool, including consensus_iptm_mean 0.7113, is computed on that 563 subset, and coverage was never random, so a figure recomputed on all 2018 is not comparable. n_engines_scored records it per design. (3) Non-expressed designs are labelled non-binders (208 of 2018 are expressed=False). On the 563 subset this is 20 of 305 negatives and excluding them moves consensus_iptm_mean by -0.002 (0.7113 -> 0.7093), so it is immaterial HERE -- but the identical conflation on our own 125-design CALCA panel is 11 of 26 negatives and moves that AUC by ~0.22. Do not carry the 'immaterial' finding to a smaller pool. The expressed column ships so the filter is available. (4) DO NOT take labels from 00_source_data/master_designs.csv -- its flat binding/kd columns are unreliable. The exports are long-format per (design, target) with replicates, and flattening to one row per design silently picks a target and a replicate. 113 designs (4.5%) were counter-screened against a second target, so a wrong pick yields a chimeric row. The visible symptom: master_designs.csv shows nipah-glycoprotein-g with 927 designs and 1 binder (0.1%) because the nipah competition also screened against human-serum-albumin and the flat file picked the wrong call. These labels are built from `evaluations` instead and were verified against it on 2026-10-03: 2018/2018 matched, and the two egfr/il7r rows that disagreed with the older flat-file build were corrected (binders 323 -> 325). master_designs.csv was also wrong on expression: 1795/223 against the export's 1810/208. (5) WHY THE `outcome` COLUMN EXISTS, added 2026-10-04: on our own SPOC panels an empty Kd cell was read as 'tested, did not bind' when it in fact marked designs that had never been ordered -- the sheet recorded that with a divider row, and one panel used an explicit 'N/A' for tested-and-not-bound which pd.read_csv silently converts to NaN. Eleven such rows dragged a 114-design AUC from 0.706 to 0.4835. This pool was never affected (its labels carry an explicit expression flag and a binding call per row), but the column is now required for every pool so that a design with no experimental outcome is structurally incapable of becoming a negative, rather than relying on whoever imports it remembering.
